correctness.rationale: The polynomial Q(hL) is positive definite for all h>=0; the determinant D_n has degree 3(n-1). A formal log/determinant recurrence and a matrix numerator recurrence prove the exact polynomial identity including its trailing degrees. Exact integer coefficients of (1+h)^{M_n}N_{ij} are all nonnegative and nonzero for every entry on P_2 through P_13 (with M values 0,1,17,66,451). P_1 is trivial. P_14 at h=5/2 has the asserted negative rational endpoint entry, independently reproduced by rational Gaussian elimination. The attached standard-library code checks 111905 coefficient/sign conditions and does not substitute sampling for a proof.

value.rationale: The smallest path-graph size permitting completed-step positivity loss for an established order-five stiff RK method is a natural all-real-step cutoff, not a chosen timestep or isolated computation. The sharp 13/14 boundary contrasts numerical stability with positivity, and the proof supplies a reusable exact polynomial positivity certificate across infinitely many timesteps. It does not require a downstream theorem to be mathematically useful.
